name: Jaakko Nurkka
headline: Co-Founder avoltra | Prev. Cliniserve, AWS, CDTM, TUM, UC Berkeley
summary:
I am a tech entrepreneur located in Munich, Germany. I'm currently building an agentic energy operating system for large commercial and industrial energy consumers as CTO.

I've previously built a B2B SaaS business as Co-Founder and CTO of Cliniserve, helped Software Vendors transition to SaaS at AWS and published in the Harvard Business Review.

I hold a Master's degree from in Management & Technology from TUM and have also studied at UC Berkeley, Center for Digital Technology & Management (CDTM) and Tampere University of Technology.

positions.title: Co-Founder & CTO
positions.description: At avoltra, we are helping the 🏭 industrial backbone of 🇪🇺 save energy costs and manage risk exposure with an AI-powered software that helps energy procurers make data-driven energy procurement decisions in real-time.

positions.title: CTO on-demand - Freelance Consultant
positions.description: I'm helping SaaS startups accelerate their product development by sharing and implementing the learnings I've made over 7 years of building Cliniserve as CTO. I try to help CTOs and CPOs avoid some of the mistakes I made to be able to deliver a great product fast while also being able to sleep well at night not worrying about things breaking apart. Some of the things that I focus on include: infrastructure setup (IaC, k8s), DevOps, observability, product analytics as well as hiring & engineering leadership. I also help early stage companies rapidly build and deploy their first AI applications.

positions.title: Co-Founder & CTO
positions.description:
Cliniserve is a healthcare SaaS company that makes hospital nursing better and enables a better utilisation of scarce personnel resources in hospitals with innovative task and shortfall management solutions. As co-founder and CTO, I was part of building the company from idea to a cashflow positive business with over 50 customers across Europe and raising multiple Million € in equity funding on the way. 

As CTO, I am responsible for our product management and software engineering efforts
* Developed two SaaS solutions, each achieving six-figure ARR, by leading an interdisciplinary team of nine product and engineering professionals
* Engineered secure cloud-native software systems that comply with stringent data protection and IT security standards of hospitals, utilizing end-to-end encryption, hybrid cloud architectures, and pseudonymization.
* Managed scalable infrastructure on AWS and OVH Cloud (OpenStack), employing Terraform and Kubernetes for efficient orchestration and scalability
* Established an effective engineering org with strong culture and DevOps setup, enabling rapid iterations and continuous experimentation through state-of-the-art tooling and processes, including trunk-based development, strong CI/CD & QA automation, and usage of feature flags. This setup supported multiple deployments per day to production, a cycle time below two days and a merge frequency of five pull requests per engineer per week.

Beyond my technical responsibilities, I have also led our Human Resources efforts, including hiring a team of 17 members, fostering a strong organizational culture with an average employee tenure of five years.

positions.title: Intern, AWS Partner Program
positions.description: I wrote my master's thesis on the servitization of product offerings in the software industry. Consequently, I conduct an event study to understand how investors react to such business model transformations and what makes companies successful in the transformation.

company.description:
Strategic energy procurement. Strengthening industry sustainably.

avoltra makes energy procurement smarter for industrial companies – data-driven, flexible, and sustainable.
Our AI-powered platform helps businesses reduce energy costs, minimize price risks, and build a future-proof energy portfolio.

The challenge:
Volatile energy markets, complex processes, and rising cost pressures make strategic and economical procurement difficult.

Our solution:
🔹 Integration of all energy-relevant data, processes, and market insights into one platform
🔹 AI-powered, flexible strategies for planning, purchasing, and optimization
🔹 Real-time market data for informed decisions and maximum execution confidence

Our drive:
We equip energy procurement teams with the tools to act confidently, economically, and sustainably—even in uncertain markets—for greater future security and a stronger industry.

You shape the industrial future—we deliver the energy intelligence.
Let’s power what’s next. 🌍
